original: Part of a base Echo network.
english: Part of a base Echo network.

original: Makes current from the wind, day and night: up to 2 kE/tick in a strong wind. Does not work under a roof. Connects by itself to a converter or relay nearby.
english: Makes current from the wind, day and night: up to 2 kE/tick in a strong wind. Does not work under a roof. Connects by itself to a converter or relay nearby.
russian: Вырабатывает ток от ветра, днём и ночью: до 2 kE/tick при сильном ветре. Под крышей не работает. Сам подключается к преобразователю или ретранслятору рядом.

original: Makes current from sunlight, only during the day: up to 1 kE/tick at noon, less when overcast. Does not work under a roof.
english: Makes current from sunlight, only during the day: up to 1 kE/tick at noon, less when overcast. Does not work under a roof.
russian: Вырабатывает ток от солнца, только днём: до 1 kE/tick в полдень, в облачность меньше. Под крышей не работает.

original: Burns fuel from its compartment at up to 2 kE/tick. Firewood holds 16 kE, Rift materials 64 to 512 kE. Works at any time.
english: Burns fuel from its compartment at up to 2 kE/tick. Firewood holds 16 kE, Rift materials 64 to 512 kE. Works at any time.
russian: Сжигает топливо из отсека со скоростью до 2 kE/tick. В дровах 16 kE, в материалах Изнанки от 64 до 512 kE. Работает в любое время.

original: The heart of the base network: turns up to 8 kE/tick of current into Echo, 1.5 times more at night. Needs an energy crystal. Buffer 256 kE. Everything within 32 m connects to it by itself.
english: The heart of the base network: turns up to 8 kE/tick of current into Echo, 1.5 times more at night. Needs an energy crystal. Buffer 256 kE. Everything within 32 m connects to it by itself.
russian: Сердце сети базы: превращает до 8 kE/tick тока в Эхо, ночью в 1,5 раза больше. Нужен энергетический кристалл. Буфер 256 kE. Всё в 32 м подключается к нему само.

original: Stores 2048 kE of Echo and takes in or gives out up to 16 kE/tick: fills during the day, gives it back at night. Several storages add up. Two side slots (up arrow) drain energy cells into the base grid.
english: Stores 2048 kE of Echo and takes in or gives out up to 16 kE/tick: fills during the day, gives it back at night. Several storages add up. Two side slots (up arrow) drain energy cells into the base grid.
russian: Хранит 2048 kE Эхо, принимает и отдаёт до 16 kE/tick: днём набирает, ночью отдаёт. Несколько накопителей складываются. Сбоку 2 гнезда со стрелкой вверх: энергоячейки в них отдают заряд в запас сети.

original: Hang Echo tanks, an Echo battery and energy cells on the station: charges them at up to 8 kE/tick without losses (slots with a down arrow). Cells in the up-arrow slots give their energy to the base grid at up to 8 kE/tick. A full cell goes to the up-arrow slot by itself, an empty one to the down-arrow slot. Does not accept cold fusion.
english: Hang Echo tanks, an Echo battery and energy cells on the station: charges them at up to 8 kE/tick without losses (slots with a down arrow). Cells in the up-arrow slots give their energy to the base grid at up to 8 kE/tick. A full cell goes to the up-arrow slot by itself, an empty one to the down-arrow slot. Does not accept cold fusion.
russian: Повесь на станцию баки, аккумулятор Эхо и энергоячейки: заряжает до 8 kE/tick без потерь (гнёзда со стрелкой вниз). Ячейки в гнёздах со стрелкой вверх отдают энергию в запас сети, до 8 kE/tick. Полная ячейка сама встаёт в разрядку, пустая — в зарядку. Холодный синтез не принимает.

original: Drive or step onto it: tanks and batteries installed in the car, and gear worn by the player, charge. Takes 8 kE/tick from the network and gives 4: half is lost on the way.
english: Drive or step onto it: tanks and batteries installed in the car, and gear worn by the player, charge. Takes 8 kE/tick from the network and gives 4: half is lost on the way.
russian: Заедь или встань: заряжаются баки и аккумулятор в машине и надетое снаряжение. Берёт из сети 8 kE/tick, отдаёт 4: половина теряется в пути.

original: Extends the base network another 32 m from itself.
english: Extends the base network another 32 m from itself.
russian: Продлевает сеть базы ещё на 32 м от себя.

original: Goes into the resonance converter. Wears out as it makes Echo: enough for 2048 kE, then it crumbles.
english: Goes into the resonance converter. Wears out as it makes Echo: enough for 2048 kE, then it crumbles.
russian: Вставляется в резонансный преобразователь. Изнашивается, пока делает Эхо: хватает на 2048 kE, потом рассыпается.

original: Goes into the resonance converter instead of an energy crystal and never wears out.
english: Goes into the resonance converter instead of an energy crystal and never wears out.
russian: Вставляется в резонансный преобразователь вместо энергетического кристалла и никогда не изнашивается.

original: A build kit for an Echo base device. Place it on the ground and it assembles in about 10 seconds. A device is taken apart back into its kit with a wrench or screwdriver; it must be empty first.
english: A build kit for an Echo base device. Place it on the ground and it assembles in about 10 seconds. A device is taken apart back into its kit with a wrench or screwdriver; it must be empty first.
russian: Набор для постройки устройства Эхо-сети. Поставь на землю — соберётся примерно за 10 секунд. Обратно в набор устройство разбирается ключом или отвёрткой, сначала его нужно опустошить.
